verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open finance aggregator, so an end-user consent management portal is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents no surface where users can view or revoke app access to their bank data. The Connect Widget, link management, and external_id are about creating links, not a user-facing consent portal, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
